title: Sea of Typhoons
content:
[[Jahur]] is on the coast of the Sea of Typhoons. [[Bucket kelp]] ([[26.33]]) is endemic to the Sea. The [[Nekh]] believe that they are heirs to an empire that stretched from the Sea of Typhoons westward. The Lonely Crags ([[19.33]]) rise from the Sea.
